name: Soba Mask
effect:
If you have a [San-Gorou] or [Sanji] Character with 7000 base power or more, give this card in your hand −5 cost.
[On Play] Return all of your [San-Gorou] and [Sanji] Characters to the owner's hand.

official_faq.question: If I have a [Sanji] with 6000 base power or less on my field, does this card in my hand get −5 cost?
official_faq.answer: No, it does not. This effect allows you to give this card in your hand −5 cost if you have either a "[San-Gorou] with 7000 base power or more" or a "[Sanji] with 7000 base power or more" in your Character area.

official_faq.question: If I have both a [San-Gorou] with 7000 base power or more and a [Sanji] with 7000 base power or more on my field, can I give this card in my hand −10 cost?
official_faq.answer: No, you cannot. This effect allows you to give this card in your hand −5 cost if you have either a "[San-Gorou] with 7000 base power or more" or a "[Sanji] with 7000 base power or more" in your Character area.

official_faq.question: If I have a [San-Gorou] or [Sanji] Character with 7000 base power or more, can I treat this Character as having a cost of 2 and use the effect of "OP01-047 Trafalgar Law" to play it?
